'''Ada''' is a female NPC working as an appraiser at the [[Vault Underground]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ada:''' Oh, if only I could see them again...
:{{DIcon}} Hello there.
:{{DIcon}} Hi there. What do you want to see?
:'''Ada:''' Hello! Are you one of the Vault's customers?
:'''Ada:''' I'm an appraiser here. We been valuing collections for years.
:'''Ada:''' Well, but something's been bothering me for a long time. Once, the head of the Montellis brought in some items for appraisal. I evaluated them the usual way.
:'''Ada:''' At the time, I was sure it was the‘most valuable collection I'd ever handled. But to my surprise, many of the pieces seemed... almost worthless when judged by market value.
:'''Ada:''' Not long after, the collection was sealed away and has never been seen since.
:'''Ada:''' Could I have overlooked something? Oh... if only I could examine those items once more, I would be certain to appraise them with the clarity they deserve.
{{Dialogue End}}
